user.description: Enter IP and port-number for your Flashforge 3d Printer. Leave empty to auto discover printer.

auto_confirm.title: Discovered Flashforge device.
auto_confirm.description: Found printer {machine_name} on {ip_addr}. Do you want to add this printer to Home Assistant?

cross_talk_detected.title: Another app may be connected to your FlashForge printer
cross_talk_detected.description: The printer is returning data that doesn't match what Home Assistant asked for. This usually means another application (e.g. FlashPrint) is also connected to the printer at the same time. Close other connections to the printer and this should clear on its own.
